description: Use when the user wants to compare creators by their tracking code or see what social links brought in. Counts of the events a product's site or app sent to Nooticr with UTM tags (link clicks, sign-ups, purchases, installs), per utm campaign, source or medium, over the last days (1 to 90, default 28). Takes appId (from list_own_apps), optional groupBy (campaign, source or medium; default campaign) and medium (one utm_medium, e.g. social or influencer). Counts only, no person's data, not deduplicated per person; synced analytics totals are not included. A zero means not tracked or nothing came: never estimate a count. No cost to call.

appId.description: The product whose tagged links to count.

medium.description: Only this utm_medium, e.g. social or influencer.

name: get_tracked_conversions

events.description: Count per event type: link_click, signup, purchase, install.

title: Get Tracked Conversions
